_comment: Prayer List seed file template. Copy to prayer_seed.json (gitignored), fill in real names, and place at files/shared/prayer_seed.json on the device. Imported once on launch, then the app archives it so it never re-imports. Only groups and people are imported - not requests/praises/updates. Each person is { "name": "...", "note": "optional one-line context" }. A group with "people": [] is created empty so you can add people later. People with no group go in the top-level "ungrouped" list.
